This is a tent, classified in heading 6306. Subheading 6306.22 covers tents of synthetic fibers, and 6306.22.90 is the "other" provision, as opposed to 6306.22.10 for camping tents. A pop-up beach shelter is arguably a camping-type tent, so I considered that. The 6306.22.10 provision covers "Tents: Of synthetic fibers: Camping tents", and CBP rulings on similar beach shelters (for example, pop-up sun shelters) have typically classified them there, not in the "other" provision. In HTSUS, 6306.22.10 is "Camping tents" and 6306.22.90 is "Other". The statistical suffixes were 6306.22.1000 and 6306.22.9000. I'm going with 6306.22.9010 only if the item is not a camping tent. In CBP rulings for beach tents, such as the N-series rulings on pop-up beach tents, the classification was 6306.22.9000, with the reasoning that the tents are not designed for camping overnight but for sun shelter. This product is a "sun shelter" for temporary use at the beach, so I'm choosing 6306.22.9000.

{"hts_code": "6306.22.9000", "reason": "A polyester-fabric pop-up beach sun shelter is a tent of synthetic fibers under heading 6306, and it falls in the 'other' provision because it is not a camping tent."}
